purpose: manage virtual machines, containers and functions so capacity matches demand, patches are applied, and every resource has an owner and a purpose
entry_criteria: Cloud accounts and an inventory source exist
Patch and image policies are defined
procedure: Create compute only from code (infrastructure as code) and from approved, patched base images, with required tags for owner, environment and cost centre.
Right-size using measured CPU, memory and network utilization over at least two weeks, and choose scaling policies with tested limits.
Patch by replacing instances with new images through the pipeline rather than patching in place, and track images older than the policy.
Harden: no public administrative ports, instance roles with least privilege, and no long-lived credentials on instances.
Find and remove idle, orphaned and untagged resources through a scheduled report and an owner confirmation step.
Test scaling and replacement under load, and record the time to replace a failed instance.
acceptance_criteria: Compute comes from code and approved images
Every resource has an owner tag
Images are within the patch policy

validation.check: list instances launched from images older than the policy age
validation.expect: none, or each has an exception

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: An inventory report finds 14 untagged instances; owners claim nine, and five idle ones are stopped after confirmation. The fleet moves to a new base image through a rolling replacement, and the old image is retired.
